Description: An educational institution for children that precedes kindergarten.
The earlier years of primary (elementary) education, typically encompassing the first few grades of primary school.
The later years of primary (elementary) education, typically encompassing the grades preceding the transition to middle or secondary school.
The educational level between primary/elementary school and high school, typically covering grades 6 through 8.
A secondary school that usually includes grades 9 through 12.
A two-year postsecondary institution offering associate degrees and lower-division (freshman and sophomore level) undergraduate coursework.
A four-year postsecondary institution, or the upper-division (junior and senior level) undergraduate coursework within one.
Studies beyond the bachelor's degree at an institution having graduate or professional programs, undertaken to prepare for entrance into a specific field or to obtain a higher degree.
Educational programs focused on career-specific or technical/vocational skills that prepare students for direct entry into a trade or occupation.
Educational programs and instructional resources designed for adult learners pursuing education outside the traditional K-12 or college-age system.
